anchor_configuration_note: 3-TE + classifier-free guidance (mid scale, likely cfg=5). Picked as the paper's headline best per Section 'Discussion' (cfg further enhanced alignment with minor FID trade-off).

CLIPScore._note: This is CLIPScore-T2I per paper convention; matches VLM3D-Dockers 'CLIPScore' key (I2T).

FVD_CTNet._note: FVD is NOT reported in the Report2CT paper. Anchor will be set at Phase B kickoff from a 1-epoch wall-clock run on the paper-spec skeleton. Envelope widened to ±25% to absorb the unanchored baseline.

win_condition.rule: ours_final beats report2ct_our_repro in >=2 of {FID_2p5D_Avg, CLIPScore, FVD_CTNet} measured by VLM3D-Dockers on the CT-RATE valid 1000-split.
win_condition.headline_metric_priority_note: A 2/3 win that excludes FID_2p5D_Avg must be flagged in the writeup as weaker than a 2/3 win including FID_2p5D_Avg, since FID has the strongest paper anchor.
win_condition.envelope_miss_branch: If report2ct_our_repro is OUTSIDE the envelope on FID_2p5D_Avg or CLIPScore, the publishable claim downgrades to 'competitive with our reimplementation of Report2CT' (NOT 'beats Report2CT'). FVD-only envelope miss is acceptable due to the self-anchor.

metric_key_mapping._description: Map paper metric names to VLM3D-Dockers ctgen evaluation JSON keys.
